campaign.name: NA Amidate / Adamantane Opportunity
campaign.description: Kit pricing is all inclusive:  International shipping to organizer, Domestic shipping to customer, Testing (Identification, Mass, Purity)

items.name: NA Epithalon Amidate 10mg
items.description:
Category: Cellular Longevity & Bioregulator Research

An amidated analog of Epithalon engineered to enhance peptide stability during laboratory investigation. Researchers are exploring this compound in studies involving cellular aging pathways, telomere-associated biology, circadian regulation, oxidative stress response, and long-term cellular maintenance models.

Research Focus:
Cellular longevity mechanisms
Telomere biology
Circadian signaling
Oxidative stress research
Healthy aging models

items.name: P21 (Adamantane) 5mg
items.description:
Category: Neuroplasticity & Cognitive Research

A modified P21 research peptide incorporating an adamantane moiety intended to improve molecular stability for experimental applications. Commonly investigated in laboratory models examining neuroplasticity, neuronal differentiation, learning pathways, synaptic remodeling, and neurotrophic signaling.

Research Focus:
Neuroplasticity
Synaptic signaling
Memory research
Neurotrophic pathways
Cognitive laboratory models

items.name: NA Selank Amidate 10mg,
items.description:
Category: Neuroregulatory Peptide Research

An amidated version of Selank designed to improve peptide stability for research environments. Frequently studied for its influence on neurochemical signaling, stress-response pathways, GABAergic modulation, immune-neural interactions, and behavioral neuroscience models.

Research Focus:
Stress signaling
GABA pathway research
Neuroimmune interactions
Cognitive performance models
Behavioral neuroscience

items.name: NA Semax Amidate 10mg
items.description:
Category: Neurotrophic & Cognitive Research

A stabilized amidated Semax analog developed for laboratory investigation of neurotrophic signaling and neuronal communication. Researchers commonly evaluate this peptide in models involving BDNF regulation, neuroprotection, cognitive function, synaptic plasticity, and recovery-associated pathways.

Research Focus:
BDNF signaling
Neuroprotection
Cognitive research
Synaptic plasticity
Neural adaptation pathways

updates.message: Freedom has completed testing and the results are all uploaded to the GB on the site. P21 Adamantane is a complicated one to produce so purity was slightly lower than the others, but over the 98% purity requirement. Will start to get these packaged and shipped out today!

Testing update...BTLabs can not obtain standards for the Amidate versions and Adamantane at this time so they sent me an email that they will not be able to complete these anytime soon. I reached out to the lab director at Freedom and he said to have them sent over and they will get them done. Fresh batch of samples (BTLabs still has all the original samples) was pulled and shipped overnight on Friday for delivery to them Monday. I also paid the expedite fee for the batch to try and make up for the lost time sitting at BT.
The Last of this buy is starting to land in the US this week so should be arriving to me early next week!

The last package of NA Epi and NA Selank is due to land in the next day or so. Testing for these two products will be sent out at that time. The NA Semax & P21 are with the freight forwarder and will be headed our way.
All of the Epithalon & Selank now have tracking and are in transit.  When the next batch of tracking comes out I will update again.

Message from the supplier...NA Epithalon 10 kits, NA Selank 10 kits will be ready and ship to forwarder soon,   and NA Semax 10 kits will be ready 2 working days later as well. P21 is going into production as the final batch for this order.

Order has been confirmed with supplier, API allocated, and they are working on getting us on the production schedule. They only produce kits when ordered, they do not stock any finished product, so these are all custom batches needing produced.
